name: Mönchengladbach
author: pierreggt
description: Map of Mönchengladbach, Germany, from the city center to the surrounding North Rhine-Westphalia towns (Willich, Viersen, Korschenbroich, Jüchen). Residential population comes from the official 2022 census 100m population grid (Zensus 2022), with real German labor-market statistics (official employment counts and municipality-to-municipality commuter flows) anchoring all 5 modeled municipalities.
data_source: Zensus 2022 (Destatis), Beschäftigtenstatistik BA + Pendlerrechnung der Länder (regionalstatistik.de/GENESIS-Online), OSM, Overture Maps
